title: MiSide x Minecraft Mashup
tagline: Explore Mita's apartment with full Minecraft inventory, crafting, and HUD mechanics in MiSide Demo.
description: A singleplayer narrative mashup where MiSide Demo acts as the primary host, enhanced with Minecraft: Java Edition's UI, hotbar, and inventory. Collect items from around the apartment into your Minecraft slots to complete missions and survive Mita's world.
